address: 2F, Chiang Mai Marriott Hotel, 108 Chang Khlan Road, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50100, Thailand
bio: At Favola, Chiang Mai Marriott Hotel presents authentic Italian cuisine, featuring homemade pasta and ravioli crafted by the Italian head chef, all served in a dining room that blends contemporary style with a classic Italian restaurant ambience. Among the dishes, the pizzas stand out. Feel free to order half or smaller sizes, perfect for when you’re in the mood to try multiple dishes. The excellent wine selection further enhances the experience....
